paper: arXiv:2411.05576 — Zhang et al., Observation of Moire Plasmonic Skyrmion Clusters
rationale: Paper is combined theory+experiment. It contains a self-contained, mesh-free analytic theory core (Eq.1 six-plane-wave SPP interference field; Eq.2 normalized 3D polarization; Eqs.3-4 skyrmion-number-density integral) with explicit numeric claims (elementary Q=+/-1, moire cluster Q=-3 at 38.21 deg). This is reproducible without any experimental data, so it is NOT an experiment-only drop like jia2026/shen2018.

reproducible_core.model: Twisted hexagonal SPP interference; Berg-Luscher / Pontryagin topological charge
reproducible_core.elementary_lattice_Q: +1.00 per cell (exact match to paper Q=+/-1)
reproducible_core.cluster_Q_minus3: partial — needs Supplemental S5 sigma_j map + moire cell definition
